text:
alice: heads up — na-east2 console is returning 502/503s for a bunch of customers, and several control-plane API calls are timing out. looks like leader election is flapping :rotating_light:

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-243 created (P1) — assigned to @engoncall.

oliver: seeing a bunch of auth failures from the api-gateway: `error=leader not found for controlplane` in the gateway logs. routing to the controlplane leader gets TCP resets.

netops: we had transient fabric BGP flaps around 2023-11-03T18:20Z affecting na-east2 spine-agg, replaying sflow now. possible controlplane partitioning between racks.

sam: quick checks:
```
kubectl get pods -n controlplane -o wide
NAME                     READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
controlplane-0           0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   5          2d    rack-27
controlplane-1           1/1     Running            0          4d    rack-12
controlplane-2           1/1     Running            0          4d    rack-09
```
logs from controlplane-0: `leader-election: failed to acquire lease: context deadline exceeded`

engoncall: tried a soft leader bump (kill -9 main on controlplane-0) to force re-election; pod restarted but still not getting the lease. suspect network isolation between controlplane-0 and etcd replicas.

maya: checked etcd cluster health — quorum currently 2/3, but the member on rack-27 shows high RTT and occasional timeouts.

oliver: gateway healthcheck is failing fast; clients hit authz which proxies to /controlplane/v1/authz and get 502. Some clients fall back to cached tokens but most fail.

sam: temporary mitigation plan proposal:
- shift control traffic away from na-east2 to na-west1 and na-central1 (gradual, 25% steps).
- promote dedicated spare controlplane pool (dedicated-controlpool-1) to handle auth/routing while we stabilize na-east2.
- start evacuating pending GPU provisioning requests that are queueing behind controlplane requests to the dedicated pool.

netops: routing shift needs coordination — BGP communities updated to prefer na-west1, but we need to ensure cross-region peering capacity is available. current cross-region links at ~65% utilization.

sam: command ready to run if we get 👍 from exec: 
```
redwoodctl traffic shift --from na-east2 --to na-west1,na-central1 --percent-step 25 --route-policy controlplane-fallback
```

alice: 👍 do it. notify customers on status page and set maintenance note: console degraded in na-east2, failover in progress.

engoncall: starting shift now. running redwoodctl job. expect ~10s of increased p95 while caches warm.

sre-bot: traffic-shift job 98765 started by engoncall — monitor at https://ops.redwood.local/traffic/98765

20m later...

oliver: shift at 25% looks good; auth error rate down ~40% overall. console still showing hiccups for sessions with long-lived KV leases.

maya: restarted etcd member on rack-27 with `systemctl restart redwood-etcd` and watching replication lag — it dropped and caught up. leader election now stable on controlplane-1.

sam: promoting dedicated-controlpool-1 succeeded, new controlplane endpoints registered. GPU provisioning backlog drained by ~60% to the spare pool. cost note: cross-region egress and spare pool ops will add ~+32% spend for the day.

alice: good containment. next steps:
- keep shift at 50% for 30m, then reassess.
- schedule full config rollout of the controlplane network policy with stricter liveness probes to prevent future slow-leader scenarios.
- start a post-incident doc and link runbook entries.

engoncall: setting `traffic-shift` to 50%. also opened a follow-up to add a healthchecker that rejects leader candidates with >200ms etcd RTT.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-243 updated — mitigation in progress, severity remains P1. Follow-up owner: alice.

alice: thanks everyone. will own the postmortem and cost reconciliation. linking to the thread in the incident ticket.

netops: marking fabric links for a maintenance window to run deeper BGP diagnostics tomorrow 02:00Z.

sam: final note — customers routed to dedicated pool may see slightly different latency but continuity preserved. we'll revert the traffic shift when na-east2 fully healthy.

engoncall: audible — starting postmortem doc now.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-243 -> monitoring mode, will auto-close after 24h if stable.
